message.content:
This editorial illustration depicts a man wearing a light-colored long-sleeved shirt, tie, tan trousers, and white sneakers. He stands on a dark, textured ground and uses his hand to lift a corner of the surface as if it were a flexible fabric. Beneath this lifted layer, a bright, glowing landscape is revealed, featuring golden-speckled ground and several thin white wind turbines set against light green hills. In the background, dark silhouettes of industrial structures, including three flared cooling towers and two tall, striped smokestacks, are visible under a purple-grey cloudy sky. One smokestack releases a plume of grey smoke.

The top of the cover features the red masthead "TEMPO" and the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." Legible text includes "6-12 DESEMBER 2021," "RP 45.000," and "OUTLOOK EKONOMI 2022." The main headline reads "Momentum Pemulihan," followed by a paragraph starting with "Dua tahun terhuyung karena pandemi Covid-19..." Other headlines mention "UU Cipta Kerja H.102" and "RUU Tindak Pidana Kekerasan Seksual H.30." A barcode and QR code appear in the upper right.
